facts.fact: A health ministry workshop in July 2025 reviewed 2024 and first-half 2025 SNIS data in preparation for the 2024 national statistical yearbook and a first-quarter 2025 bulletin.

MRT.note: States no tiers, digitisation level or clinic coverage.

facts.fact: The health ministry says the DHIS2 platform is used nationally to collect, analyse and present health data for the SNIS.

MRT.note: Health data workshop; nothing on schools.
